column3: Equal 50/50 founder split with 4-year vesting and 12-month cliff
column5: Two founders with complementary skills (sales/ops and hardware/firmware); YC default is an equal split; contribution differences in year 1 do not predict years 2-10
column6: We will split equity 50/50 with 4-year vesting and a 12-month cliff (25 % at the cliff then 1/48 monthly); IP assigned to the company; decision rights and departure terms in the founders agreement
column7: + no relitigation of the split at every hire or raise; + a mistake can be unwound within year 1 at the cliff; - equal split cannot reward a disproportionate contributor without a new ADR; ~ vesting schedule must be reconciled with the cap table monthly

column3: Register as a stock corporation with the SEC instead of continuing as a sole proprietorship
column5: SB Corp venture program and NDC SVF require a registered corporation; clients ask for a corporate counterparty; the PH ecosystem clock (1-year track record) starts at registration
column6: We will incorporate Bayanihan Embedded Systems Inc. as a stock corporation with the SEC and register with BIR/LGU within 30 days
column7: + eligible counterparty for corporate clients and government financing; + limited liability; - annual SEC/BIR/audit compliance load; - sole-prop invoices and permits must be retired; ~ withholding bracket moves to the corporate 10/15 % class

column3: Hourly time-and-materials pricing for all engagements
column5: First two clients wanted hourly quotes; no cost floor yet; utilisation unknown
column6: We will quote every engagement hourly at PHP 1,800/h ex-VAT
column7: + simplest to quote; + no scope risk; - rewards slowness and caps margin; - clients cannot budget; ~ requires timesheets from day one
column14: replaced by milestone pricing once the cost floor and utilisation were measured

column3: Elect food-and-beverage plant retrofits in CALABARZON as the beachhead segment
column5: 14 consented interviews across 2 segments; F&B plant engineers showed past spend on downtime monitoring and 3 commitments of time; the LGU segment showed praise but no spend
column6: We will sell only to F&B plant retrofits in CALABARZON until 10 paid engagements; other segments go to a waiting list
column7: + one ICP for positioning, price book and outreach; + references cluster in one industry; - smaller SAM than the multi-segment story; ~ widening the segment needs a new ADR

column3: Viber broadcast list as a primary marketing channel
column5: Viber has high PH reach; low cost; consent captured at trade-show booth
column6: We will run a fortnightly Viber broadcast to consented plant engineers
column7: + near-zero cost; + high open rate in PH; - no qualified leads attributable; - unsubscribe handling manual; ~ consent ledger required
column14: 0 qualified leads in 3 months; channel deprecated on 2026-08-28; LinkedIn founder posts kept

column3: North Star = accepted-milestone revenue per month with five input metrics
column5: Productivity game (Amplitude): value is realised when a client accepts a milestone; DAU-style metrics are vanity for a studio
column6: We will track accepted-milestone revenue per month as the North Star with inputs: qualified leads, proposal win rate, billable utilisation, first-pass milestone acceptance, repeat/expansion share
column7: + every board exhibit derives from one KPI tree; + inputs map to owners; - lumpy month-to-month; ~ changing the North Star rebuilds OKRs and exhibits

column3: Milestone-priced fixed-scope engagements with a 30 % deposit; T&M only for support retainers
column5: Cost floor measured at 68 % utilisation gives PHP 2,150/h fully loaded; WTP interviews (n = 11) put a plant retrofit pilot at PHP 350,000-600,000; hourly quotes lost 3 of 4 proposals
column6: We will price fixed-scope engagements per milestone from the price book with a 30 % deposit on countersign; hourly T&M is limited to support retainers
column7: + clients can budget; + margin follows delivery efficiency; - scope creep must go through change orders; ~ price book reviewed quarterly

column3: Adopt the MSA + SOW templates with milestone-id payments, deemed acceptance and IP assignment on payment
column5: Every client redlines differently; a template with lawyer sign-off protects background IP and ties cash to milestone ids rather than dates
column6: We will contract only under the reviewed MSA v1 and SOW template; any redline touching IP, liability cap or payment terms needs founder unanimity
column7: + predictable cash; + IP position clear; - some clients insist on their paper; ~ lawyer re-review yearly

column3: Hire a junior embedded engineer in Q4 2026
column5: Utilisation ran at 78 % in July and August; backlog covers 62 % of Q4 plan; DEFAULT_ALIVE 1 with runway 13.7 months; payroll is the least reversible expense
column6: We will hire one junior embedded engineer at PHP 45,000/month starting 2026-11-02 if DEFAULT_ALIVE holds and Q4 backlog is above 60 % of plan at the September board
column7: + frees CTO time for DVT and sales-engineering; + capacity for the second anchor client; - adds PHP 60,000/month fully loaded burn; - onboarding cost during a DVT quarter; ~ hiring freeze rule K7 applies if headcount exceeds plan

column3: Apply for SB Corp Business Expansion Financing of PHP 1,500,000
column5: Eligible from month 3-11 of operation with 3 months of proven sales; 0 % interest for 12 months then 1 %/month diminishing; a buffer for the DVT tooling deposit without diluting equity
column6: We will apply for PHP 1,500,000 under the SB Corp Business Expansion program after the September board approves the DVT tooling ADR
column7: + non-dilutive; + 12-month interest-free window; - repayment starts before Q3 2027 revenue lands; ~ requires mayor's permit, SEC registration, bank account and business plan documents
